id: \rRoxie: You think you'll be a challenge? Well let's turn it up to eleven then and see how it goes.
en: \rRoxie: You think you'll be a challenge? Well let's turn it up to eleven then and see how it goes.
it: \rVelia: Pensi di essere una sfida? Allora alziamo il volume al massimo e vediamo come va.

id: \rIn fact, I dare you to use your whole team against me. Maybe then it will be a challenge.
en: \rIn fact, I dare you to use your whole team against me. Maybe then it will be a challenge.
it: \rAnzi, ti sfido a usare tutta la tua squadra contro di me. Magari così sarà una vera sfida.
